prompts: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: 16:9 YouTube cover background ONLY, 1536x864 or wide 16:9. A 1957 artificial intelligence laboratory rendered as a cinematic high-end editorial photograph. Composition: rightmost third contains a handsome brass and dark steel 20 by 20 photocell grid with tiny amber glass sensor circles, a few lit forming the digit 7, with vacuum tubes and one old green oscilloscope behind it. Left two thirds are deliberately very dark deep teal and unoccupied for later title typography, atmospheric but not cluttered. Tactile brushed metal, aged brass, soft amber edge light, jewel teal shadows, subtle fine film grain. Historical machinery meets a faint modern cyan data-light trail. Attractive natural depth of field, carefully restrained, crisp main object. NO words, letters, labels, logos, captions, watermark, decorative bands or diagonal ribbons. Do not render any text. All typography will be added separately by code. Save the generated image to the local filesystem so it can be used in the project.

Cinematic retro-futurist 1957 lab, a luminous emerald cathode ray oscilloscope screen at right displaying only the silhouette of a handwritten digit 7 made from phosphor pixels; surrounding dark mahogany and black bakelite, coiled copper cables, a glowing vacuum tube, fine dust illuminated in a shaft of light. The left two thirds are extremely dark nearly black forest green open atmosphere reserved for later white and lime typography. Composition distinctive from a sensor grid: close-up curved green CRT glass and circular brass dial, screen faces toward viewer, tangible old electronics, a modern cyan light filament winds around right-side machine. Luxurious sharpness, intentional negative space, analog film texture, no busy details on left. NO text, no letters or labels or numbers other than that pictorial 7, no logos, no watermark, no diagonal stripe or corner ribbon. Wide landscape 16:9.
